description: The organization has not conducted periodic risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and potential impacts to systems and data. This signal indicates that security risks may not be formally identified, documented, or prioritized.
applicability: Applicable to organizational risk management processes including threat identification, vulnerability assessment, impact analysis, and risk prioritization activities.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of risk assessment documentation, assessment schedules, risk registers, and risk management processes.
